hypotheses.title: Batch 86: Microstructure Volume Absorption Turnover Compression (Targeting Alpha 28)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly builds on Candidate 2 from Batch 85 (which demonstrated an exceptional Sharpe of 1.93 and Sub-universe Sharpe of 1.13 in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral). The raw daily signal experienced high turnover (84.88%), which penalized Fitness to 0.77. Batch 86 introduces three distinct temporal smoothing and volume-normalization mechanisms (5-day linear decay, 10-day time-series ranking, and 5-day VWAP spread smoothing) to compress turnover from 84.88% down into the 15-25% sweet spot while preserving the 1.93 Sharpe, unlocking Fitness >= 1.50 and exceptional Uniqueness.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if temporal smoothing degrades Sharpe below 1.25 or fails to compress turnover below 70%.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (5-Day Linear Decay Smoothing): Applies ts_decay_linear over a 5-day lookback to smooth daily intraday range pushes and abnormal volume shocks, stabilizing cross-sectional rankings and compressing turnover to ~20-25%. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 6.

Candidate 2 (10-Day Time-Series Rank Normalization): Ranks each stock's volume absorption shock against its own trailing 10-day history (ts_rank), isolating true statistical liquidity exhaustion outliers and eliminating cross-sectional churn. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 6.

Candidate 3 (Institutional VWAP Spread & Abnormal Volume Smoothing): Uses percentage deviation from institutional VWAP benchmark scaled by abnormal volume, smoothed over a 5-day decay window. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 6.
